title: Gurtas Lefschetz Fibrations, Rational Blowdowns, and Exotic Symplectic Four-Manifolds
summary: We study negative spheres obtained from exceptional sections of Gurtas Lefschetz fibrations. Starting with the known system of $4n$ disjoint $(-1)$-sections, we show that a marked double sum contains $4n$ symplectic $(-2)$-spheres and $2n$ smooth $(-4)$-spheres obtained by pairwise tubing. By carrying the same sections through a fourfold sum, we instead obtain $4n$ disjoint symplectic $(-4)$-spheres and hence symplectic rational blowdowns.
